Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list.  See answers below and attached draft.

1) VAT treatment: Redwood is registered for VAT in Ireland (VAT ID: IE341-XXXX). For EU customers with B2B status and a valid VAT ID, we apply reverse-charge (no VAT amount on our invoice). If CedarTech will self-account for VAT, we should include your VAT number on the invoice and a note: "reverse charge — VAT to be accounted by the recipient".

2) Attached: Invoice_E-8392_DRAFT.pdf and SOW_CedarTech_signed.pdf. We can switch the draft to final once you confirm the PO number and whether you want the invoice split into GL lines.

3) Splitting lines: yes — we can present two invoice line items: (a) Platform subscription (annual) and (b) Contract true-up (usage delta). I've put placeholders for amounts in the draft to match the final true-up calculation.

If this looks good, we'll: 1) finalize the PDF with your PO# CT-2027-4558, 2) attach Redwood VAT certificate, and 3) reissue as Final_Invoice_E-8392.pdf.

Cc'd Marcus (revenue ops) and Laura (contracts) to confirm accounting/contract offsets.

Best,
